metadata.question: Does the floodplain along Cooper Creek, downstream of Windorah, 10 km radius around (-27.667421, 141.780304), show higher vegetation greenness on April 22, 2025 than on April 6, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point (-27.667421, 141.780304) with 10 km radius - Dates: April 6, 2025 and April 22, 2025 (specific dates) - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution, good for vegetation), with Landsat 8/9 as fallback - Metric: NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) for greenness 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we're measuring vegetation greenness - Cloud cover can artificially reduce NDVI values - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 or fallback to Landsat cloud masking 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1 (typically 0.2-0.8 for vegetation) - Zero/low NDVI could be valid (water, bare soil) - C1: If no images found for either date - C2: If all pixels masked out (clouds/shadows) - C3: If NDVI calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values (>1 or <-1) - A: If April 22 NDVI > April 6 NDVI - B: If April 22 NDVI <= April 6 NDVI ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([141.780304, -27.667421]); const aoi = point.buffer(10000); // 10 km radius const date1 = '2025-04-06'; const date2 = '2025-04-22'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function getCollection(date, buffer) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(buffer, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); } // Try to get images with increasing date windows let col1 = getCollection(date1, 1); let size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); if (size1 === 0) { col1 = getCollection(date1, 3); size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); } let col2 = getCollection(date2, 1); let size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); if (size2 === 0) { col2 = getCollection(date2, 3); size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); } console.log(`Date 1 (${date1}) Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Date 2 (${date2}) Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('No images found for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } const img1 = col1.map(addNDVI).median(); const img2 = col2.map(addNDVI).median(); // 4. Check pixel counts const count1 = img1.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2 = img2.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Date 1 Valid Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Date 2 Valid Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean NDVI const ndvi1 = img1.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndvi2 = img2.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`NDVI ${date1}: ${ndvi1 !== null ? ndvi1.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); console.log(`NDVI ${date2}: ${ndvi2 !== null ? ndvi2.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (ndvi1 === null || ndvi2 === null || isNaN(ndvi1) || isNaN(ndvi2)) { console.log('NDVI calculation returned invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (ndvi1 < -1 || ndvi1 > 1 || ndvi2 < -1 || ndvi2 > 1) { console.log('NDVI values outside valid range [-1, 1].'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Difference (Apr 22 - Apr 6): ${(ndvi2 - ndvi1).toFixed(3)}`); if (ndvi2 > ndvi1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
